name: M3_MMS200MI_LstItmWhsByItm
description: List item–warehouse settings for a specific item or for all items in scope. The operation returns every warehouse that is connected to an item, optionally restricted by company, warehouse and item number. The result mirrors the item/warehouse setup from Item/Warehouse (MMS002), including identification (company, warehouse, item, descriptions) plus a wide range of warehouse‑specific parameters for planning, allocation, costing, quality control and logistics. Use it to see how an item is configured per warehouse, or to compare warehouse behavior (for example lead times, safety stock, ABC classes and allocation rules) across the network.

inputParameters.description: Company in which to search for item/warehouse records.

inputParameters.name: WHLO

inputParameters.name: ITNO
inputParameters.description: Item number to list connected warehouse records for.

inputParameters.name: LNCD
